rules.statement: Courts generally will not issue a writ where a plaintiff has unexcused delay causing prejudice to the defendant, due to the principle of laches.
rules.supporting_quote: 1. The appellant was guilty of laches. He had failed to adduce any acceptable reason to excuse the delay. The delay had caused prejudice to the deceased (the tenant). 2. In the aforesaid circumstances the court will generally not issue the writ in the exercise of its discretion

meta.parties: Issadeen v. The Commissioner of National Housing and Others
